categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in semiconductor-related products, environmental engineering and factory systems, LED/LCD/electronic materials, green energy and circular economy, and lifestyle-related industries including health and sports. It provides precision materials, process equipment, and components for semiconductor, LCD, and LED industries, along with integrated system planning and services. The group also engages in environmental protection and green energy sectors such as wastewater treatment, clean rooms, solar power station engineering, and has expanded into health-related fields including fresh food, biotech, leisure tourism, and sports training.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced semiconductor materials technology including photoresists, silicon wafers, quartz products, chemical mechanical polishing liquids, and packaging materials. It develops proprietary advanced packaging adhesives and primers for 5G/6G substrates, and environmental technologies such as advanced wastewater treatment systems, ozone catalytic oxidation, and precision dosing control systems. The company also employs system integration for equipment installation, maintenance, and semiconductor foundry services, and invests in R&D for low-carbon and sustainable products with patented technologies in wastewater and chemical processing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are semiconductor manufacturers, LCD and LED producers, and electronic component industries primarily in Taiwan and China. The company serves foundries, IC design firms, and packaging/testing companies, as well as environmental and green energy sectors including semiconductor fabs and panel makers. It also targets emerging markets in health, food processing, and sports industries. Major end markets include semiconductor fabrication, advanced packaging, green energy projects, and lifestyle consumer sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan and China, with expanding presence in the United States, Japan, Vietnam, Southeast Asia (Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand), and plans for Europe and India. It has overseas subsidiaries and sales offices to support global supply chain diversification and customer proximity. The company also provides environmental and green energy services in Taiwan, Southeast Asia, and China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company functions as a midstream to downstream integrator and distributor within the semiconductor supply chain, providing advanced materials, equipment, and integrated services. It acts as an agent and system integrator for semiconductor process materials and equipment, environmental engineering solutions, and green energy systems. It also offers foundry service platforms and equipment maintenance, positioning itself as a full-service provider bridging upstream suppliers and downstream manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include global expansion with a focus on semiconductor advanced process materials and new product development, especially in AI, 5G/6G, electric vehicles, and advanced packaging. The company emphasizes R&D in proprietary materials, environmental technologies, and circular economy solutions. It pursues M&A to accelerate growth in AI and ESG-related businesses, promotes IPOs of subsidiaries, and integrates AI applications to enhance operational efficiency. R&D efforts target advanced adhesives, primers, environmental treatment technologies, and smart control systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of semiconductor materials, electronic components, environmental engineering services, and green energy solutions. The company also earns income from system integration, equipment installation and maintenance services, and consulting for semiconductor foundry services. It engages in agency and distribution agreements with major suppliers and provides value-added services to customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position as a comprehensive semiconductor supply chain integrator in Taiwan, with strong exclusive agency relationships with major suppliers like Shin-Etsu Chemical. It competes with other semiconductor material distributors and environmental engineering firms. Its market share in Taiwan for photoresists is about 50%, and for quartz products about 59%. The company differentiates itself through high-quality products, integrated services, and strong technical support, maintaining competitive advantages in advanced process materials and environmental solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved record consolidated revenue of approximately NT$57 billion and net profit of NT$3.665 billion, reflecting strong growth driven by semiconductor demand. Total assets increased 18% year-over-year to NT$37.3 billion, with shareholders' equity rising 17%. The company maintains healthy liquidity with a current ratio of 144%. Revenue and profit growth are supported by expanding overseas operations and diversified business segments. R&D expenditure was about NT$66.6 million in 2024, with a planned increase to NT$70 million in 2025.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes stable high-quality products, timely delivery, and rapid service to meet customer needs in advanced semiconductor manufacturing. It offers integrated system planning and total service solutions, including equipment installation, maintenance, and foundry support. Its proprietary R&D and patented technologies in advanced materials and environmental treatment provide competitive differentiation. The company also focuses on sustainability and ESG commitments, integrating green manufacturing solutions and promoting circular economy practices to create long-term value for customers and stakeholders.
